text_block_list.text: I kept waiting for Rice Shower, and as the sun began to set...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry...!
I was looking for something in the park...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... the person who lost something
wasn't Rice, it was a little girl in the park.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That child asked me to help search together because she lost her hat...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice told them it'd be bad luck if Rice got involved, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The little girl just kept crying,
and there was no one else around, so...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I found it right away, but it got blown away by the wind, so it took some time...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Still, when I gave her the hat, the little girl was so happy... It made me glad.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Still, that's no excuse for skipping training, is it... I'm sorry.

While what she did was right in principle,
I made sure to firmly remind her to contact me
next time beforehand.
